title: perfoliata ciliata
intro: Perfoliata ciliata, commonly known as Indian tobacco or Bidens pilosa, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of fever. Perfoliata ciliata has been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its potential in treating various diseases. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may help in managing conditions such as diabetes, arthritis, and respiratory infections.
